script: This morning, I stopped at a small cafe before work. I ordered an iced latte and gave my name, Mina. The cafe was noisy, so the barista wrote Nina on the cup. A woman named Nina picked it up by mistake. When she tasted it, she came back and said, "I think this latte is not mine." The barista made a new drink for both of us and wrote order numbers after that.

choices.text: 화자는 출근 전에 작은 카페에 들렀다.
화자는 따뜻한 아메리카노를 주문했다.
바리스타는 컵에 Mina 대신 Nina라고 적었다.
Nina는 음료를 마시지 않고 바로 버렸다.
바리스타는 이후 이름 대신 테이블 번호를 쓰기 시작했다.

script: Hi, this is a message for the bus company. I think I left my earbuds on one of your buses during my ride. They are small, white, and inside a dark blue case. I was sitting near the middle door, on the right side. I remember putting the case in the seat pocket because I was holding my bag and a cup of tea. When I got off near the library, I forgot to take it. The bus was going to the central station. If someone finds it, please call me back. My name is Hana Park. I can come to the lost and found office after work. The earbuds are not new, but I use them every day for my English lessons.

choices.text: 하나는 버스에서 이어버드를 잃어버렸다.
이어버드 케이스는 진한 파란색이다.
하나는 이어버드를 도서관 책상 위에 두고 왔다.
하나는 버스 앞문 근처에 앉아 있었다.
이어버드는 새 제품이라서 환불을 받으려 한다.

script: Excuse me, I picked up my laundry a short time ago, but I think there is a problem. The bag has my receipt number on it, but the clothes inside are not mine. There are two black shirts, a gray jacket, and a red scarf. I brought in three white shirts and one pair of navy pants. I checked the pockets, and there is a movie ticket in the gray jacket, so maybe another customer got my bag by mistake. I am still nearby, so I can return to the shop now. Could you please check if my clothes are still there? I need the white shirts for work, so I would really like to get them back soon.

choices.text: 손님은 세탁소에서 다른 사람의 옷을 받은 것 같다.
손님이 맡긴 옷은 흰 셔츠 세 벌과 남색 바지 한 벌이다.
가방 안에는 흰 셔츠와 남색 바지가 들어 있었다.
손님은 이미 멀리 가서 다시 갈 수 없다고 말한다.
회색 재킷 주머니에는 버스표가 들어 있었다.

script: Hi, Daniel. This is your neighbor, Sora, from apartment 804. A delivery driver left a package in front of my door, but the name on the box is yours. I think he read the floor number wrong. The box is not very big, but it looks a little heavy. It says glass on one side, so I put it inside my apartment to keep it safe. I will be home for a while, and after that I have to go to my piano lesson. If you want, you can knock on my door before I leave. If not, I can bring it to you later. Please send me a message when you hear this.

choices.text: 소라는 다니엘의 택배를 자신의 집 안에 보관하고 있다.
상자에는 유리 제품이라는 표시가 있다.
택배 기사는 다니엘의 집 문 앞에 정확히 상자를 놓았다.
소라는 곧 수영 수업에 가야 한다.
상자는 매우 작고 가벼워 보인다고 말한다.

script: Hey, everyone. About our picnic, I checked the sky, and it is already raining hard near the park. The grass will be too wet, and it will be difficult to sit outside. So let's change the plan. Please do not go to the park. Instead, meet at my apartment. I have a big table, and we can eat inside. I already bought bread, fruit, and juice. Jason, could you still bring the sandwiches? Anna, you do not need to bring paper cups because I have enough cups here. If anyone is late, call me before you arrive, because the front door code sometimes does not work well.

choices.text: 비 때문에 소풍 장소가 공원에서 말하는 사람의 아파트로 바뀌었다.
안나는 종이컵을 가져오지 않아도 된다.
공원의 잔디가 말라 있어서 밖에 앉기 좋다고 한다.
제이슨은 과일과 주스를 사 와야 한다.
늦는 사람은 도착한 뒤에만 연락하면 된다고 한다.

script: Hello, I am calling about a locker key at your gym. I finished my exercise and returned the towel, but I forgot to give back the locker key. I only noticed it when I found it in my coat pocket at the bus stop. The number on the key is 27. I am sorry about that. I cannot come back right now because I have a meeting soon, but I can return it later. Please do not charge me for a lost key yet. The locker was empty when I left, and I did not take anything from it. If you need my member number, it is written on the card I used at the front desk.

choices.text: 말하는 사람은 헬스장 사물함 열쇠를 반납하지 않고 가져왔다.
열쇠 번호는 27번이다.
말하는 사람은 열쇠를 잃어버려서 번호를 모른다.
사물함 안에는 아직 물건이 남아 있다고 말한다.
말하는 사람은 바로 헬스장으로 돌아갈 수 있다고 한다.

script: Hi, this is Emma from the city library. I am calling about your new library card. You filled out the form yesterday, but one piece of information is missing. We need your apartment number before we can finish the card. You do not need to visit the library again today. Please call us before six this evening, or send the number by email. After we receive it, your card will be ready tomorrow afternoon. You can pick it up at the front desk. Please bring your photo ID when you come. Thank you.

choices.text: 도서관 카드 신청서에 아파트 번호가 빠졌다.
오늘 다시 도서관에 방문해야 한다.
카드는 내일 오후에 준비될 예정이다.
카드를 받으려면 학생증만 가져가면 된다.
도서관은 오늘 저녁 8시까지 전화를 받는다.

script: Hello, this is Daniel from Green Street Shoe Repair. I am calling about the brown boots you left with us on Monday. The new heel is finished, but we also found a small problem with the zipper on the left boot. We can fix it today for five dollars more. If you do not want the zipper fixed, the boots are ready now. Our shop closes at seven tonight. We are closed tomorrow morning, but we open again at two in the afternoon. Please call us and tell us what you would like to do.

choices.text: 갈색 부츠의 새 굽 수리는 끝났다.
오른쪽 부츠의 지퍼에 문제가 있다.
지퍼 수리는 무료로 해 준다.
가게는 오늘 밤 7시에 문을 닫는다.
가게는 내일 아침 일찍 문을 연다.

script: Excuse me, everyone. This is an announcement from Maple Market. A small black wallet was found near the fruit counter about ten minutes ago. It has a silver button on the front. There is no money inside, but there are two cards and a photo. If this wallet is yours, please come to the service desk near the main door. We will ask you to describe the photo before we return it. Please do not ask the cashiers about the wallet, because they are helping other customers. Thank you for listening.

choices.text: 검은색 지갑이 과일 코너 근처에서 발견되었다.
지갑 안에는 현금과 카드 세 장이 들어 있다.
주인은 사진을 설명해야 지갑을 돌려받을 수 있다.
지갑은 계산대 직원에게 맡겨져 있다.
지갑 앞에는 금색 단추가 있다.

script: Hi, this message is for Sarah Kim. This is Bright Dental Clinic. Your cleaning appointment is still on Friday, but the time has changed. The dentist has an emergency meeting at three, so we moved your appointment from three thirty to four fifteen. If four fifteen is not good for you, we can also see you next Tuesday morning at ten. Please call us before noon tomorrow to confirm. You do not need to bring any forms, because we already have your information. Please arrive ten minutes early if you keep the Friday appointment.

choices.text: 금요일 치과 예약 시간이 4시 15분으로 바뀌었다.
예약은 금요일에서 목요일로 변경되었다.
금요일 예약을 유지하면 10분 일찍 도착해야 한다.
새 환자 서류를 반드시 가져가야 한다.
내일 오후 5시까지 확인 전화를 해야 한다.

script: Hello, this is Nina from Corner Bookstore. I am calling about the travel book you ordered last week. Good news, it arrived this morning. We will keep it behind the counter for three days. The price is twelve dollars, the same as we told you before. Please bring the order paper or show this message on your phone when you come. The blue notebook you asked about is not here yet. It should arrive later this week. Our store is open until eight tonight.

choices.text: 주문한 여행 책이 오늘 아침 도착했다.
서점은 책을 일주일 동안 보관해 준다.
책 가격은 이전에 안내한 것보다 올랐다.
파란 공책은 아직 도착하지 않았다.
서점은 오늘 저녁 6시에 문을 닫는다.

script: Hi, Mark. This is Jisoo from the office. I think I left my phone charger in the small meeting room after lunch. It is white, with a blue sticker near the plug. I used it during our design meeting, and then I put it next to the window because the table was full. When I came back from the coffee shop, another team was already using the room, so I could not check. If you are still at the office, could you look for it before you leave? I need it tonight because my phone battery is low. If you find it, please put it in my desk drawer, not at the front desk.

choices.text: 지수는 점심 후 작은 회의실에 휴대폰 충전기를 두고 온 것 같다.
충전기는 흰색이고 플러그 근처에 파란 스티커가 있다.
지수는 충전기를 커피숍 창가 자리에 두고 왔다.
마크는 충전기를 찾으면 안내 데스크에 맡겨야 한다.
지수는 다른 팀이 회의실을 쓰기 전에 직접 확인했다.

script: Hello, this is Grace from Sunny Pharmacy. I am calling about your medicine order. You asked us to prepare it for pickup this afternoon, but one item is not ready yet. The allergy tablets arrived this morning, so you can pick them up today. However, the cough syrup will arrive tomorrow after lunch. I am sorry for the delay. If you only need the tablets, please come before seven tonight. If you want to pick up both items together, tomorrow after two is better. Please bring your health card when you come. You do not need to call again unless you want us to cancel the cough syrup.

choices.text: 알레르기 알약은 오늘 받을 수 있다.
기침 시럽은 내일 점심 이후에 도착할 예정이다.
두 약 모두 오늘 아침에 준비가 끝났다.
알레르기 알약만 필요해도 내일까지 기다려야 한다.
약을 받으러 갈 때 여권을 가져가야 한다.
